required_before_target_freeze: Capture selected public assets with official metadata checksums and an immutable per-file transfer manifest.
Resolve the PXD052701 LF1-L through LF5-S material and size covariates from a source-matched reusable record; do not infer L/S semantics from file names.
Define one versioned common protein-crown endpoint and process each selected source with the same declared parser/search/quantification rule before cross-study comparison.
Retain study, laboratory, acquisition mix, source run, fraction, channel, technical replicate and biological-replicate status separately; unknown replication remains unknown.
Revise and freeze the T121 analysis plan with effective-n, group split, negative control, ablation and OOD requirements for the admitted target.
Create raw prediction, paired-ablation and study-held-out archives only after the frozen target and configurations pass their strict gates.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not concatenate author-reported label-free, TMT or semi-quantitative values into a common abundance scale.
Do not treat source file names, TMT fractions or multiplex channels as independent biological replicates.
Do not fit a model, report ablations or claim OOD behaviour from the preflight registry.
